Necroth seems to be a place filled with crypts that emit large columns of bones. The bones seem to react with purpose, forming a structure. In the non-canon Warcraft Adventures, Thrall obtains three scrolls from Drek'Thar, one of which is a spell that summons a bridge from Necroth. The spell requires a bone as a reagent in order for it to work. Thrall says an incantation in order for the scroll to work which sounds like, "Dim balana gradazor. Nerada kurzol ne." The visual effects of spell include a summoning of a large monster from Necroth, who subsequently turns into a walkable bridge. Thrall uses it to traverse to the other side of the chasm.

Nerubians are an ancient race of highly intelligent arachnoids and insectoids. Native to Northrend, these spider-men once ruled over the kingdom of Azjol-Nerub that stretched like a great web beneath the desolate glaciers of "the roof of the world". However, the Lich King crushed their dark empire and sent them skittering into the arctic wastelands. Though there were few pockets of nerubian warriors left, they still sought to gain vengeance upon Ner'zhul and reclaim their subterranean kingdom.

Nethergarde Keep, also known as the Citadel of Nethergarde, was a Dalaranian fortress of dour mages and paladins, built to keep watch over the Dark Portal. It stood on a high bluff along the only road into the Blasted Lands, a road often traveled by both the Horde and the Alliance as they prepared to do battle with the demonic forces in the region. Nethergarde Keep was a heavily defended Alliance town located in the Blasted Lands. Although technically it was a castle like Northwatch Hold in the Barrens, none of the guards were PvP-enabled except the Gryphon Master and a few questgivers. Nerglish (or murloc) is the native guttural language of the murloc race, as well as the primary language of the makrura and a few other aquatic races. The language namely consists of the murlocs' iconic gurgling battle cry. Nerglish is "impossibly difficult" to decipher, causing the murlocs' supposed intelligence to be seen as debatable by non-murlocs. Despite this, other races such as night elves can learn and speak the language fluently. The language is described as difficult to get one's tongue around the subtleties of pronunciation, but is a beautifully expressive language. __NOTOC__ Nethercleft Leg Armor is an armor kit which permanently applies +40 stamina and +12 agility modifications to leg armor, in the same virtual "slot" as an enchantment. Neurbian workers are large creatures that have the lower body of a giant spider with a humanoid torso. Their arms and head are spiderlike. Their six spider legs are long and thin, allowing them to top ten feet when they rear up. Workers deal with the larger needs of the community: food, weaponsmithing, mining, building, and supplying the needs of the other castes. Their lives are unending labors, though they do not chafe at them. Unlike insects, nerubian workers need to rest; in the Sundered Monolith, workers sleep in small nests that line the walls of great living caverns. Nerubian workers avoid combat. Nether-Wraith Essence dropped from Furious Nether-wraiths in the Netherstorm.
Nether-Wraith Beacon is provided as an objective for Becoming a Spellfire Tailor.
Neophyte's Pants are the starting legs for human, dwarf, night elf, undead, troll, and blood elf priests. It can also be purchased for from in Old Hillsbrad Foothills.
Nether Dragon Essence drops from Nether Drakes and Nether Dragons in the Netherstorm.
Neophyte's Robe is part of the starting outfit for blood elf, human, dwarf, undead, troll, and night elf priests. This item can also be purchased for from in Old Hillsbrad Foothills.
Nether Gem is provided as an objective for The Prodigal Lich Returns.
Nerubis Centurions are crypt fiends found in Deatholme in the Ghostlands.
__NOTOC__ Nerubis Guards are crypt fiends found at Suncrown Village in the Ghostlands.
The Neru Fragment is contained in a batch of Loose Soil in the Wetlands.

Netherdust Bush yields the Netherdust Pollen and Netherwing Eggs that can be gathered by Herbalists and are used for gaining reputation with the Netherwing faction. It also contains Motes of Mana and Fel Lotuses.

Nether drake mounts all summon Netherwing drakes, and all the PvE ones require status with Netherwing to acquire. When you first achieve with Netherwing, you are given the opportunity to acquire a free Netherwing drake mount via a quest.

Nether Exhaustion is a debuff obtained during the fight against Netherspite in Karazhan. This debuff has 3 variations, red, blue and green, which prevents you from intercepting another portal of the same color for 1 minute and 30 seconds.
Nether Residue is a quest objective for the Gaining the Advantage daily quest.

The nerubian king is a single spiderlord who becomes the ruler of the entire nerubian people. He is in charge over the nerubian queens. The nerubian king ruled Azjol-Nerub from its former capital where Icecrown Glacier now resides. The former nerubian king was crypt lord Anub'arak who still rules Azjol-Nerub for the Scourge.
Spiderlings are nerubian young. They are hatched from the eggs of queens in breeding pods, as well as upon the death of some living adults. They can also hatch from unfortunate captured creatures.
Nether-stalkers are ethereal trackers. Most known nether-stalkers are members of the Consortium.

Nerves of Cold Steel is a Death knight talent located in the 2nd tier of the Frost Tree. Maxing this talent, along with Threat of Thassarian further down in the tree, is essential for any death knight who wishes to dual wield.
Nerub'ar Web Lords are crypt lords found outside Warsong Hold in the Borean Tundra.
Nesingwary Lackey Ears can be found on the corpses of several Borean Tundra humanoid mobs, including Loot Crazed Divers, Loot Crazed Hunters and Loot Crazed Poachers.
__NOTOC__ Nesingwary Trappers are Broken, goblins, and Forsaken found in the Borean Tundra. They can be enticed to kill themselves by placing some fur from the Pile of Fake Furs on a Caribou Trap.
The Netherbreath Spellblade drops from Skadi the Ruthless in Utgarde Pinnacle on heroic mode.
__NOTOC__ Nether Pigment is obtained from milling herbs native to Outland. Milled from: * Felweed * Ragveil * Dreaming Glory * Ancient Lichen * Terocone * Nightmare Vine * Netherbloom * Mana Thistle
Nepeta Leaf is a reputation reward; you must be with Frenzyheart Tribe to buy it from for .
The Nerubian Reinforced Quiver is crafted with Leatherworking (415); taught by Pattern: Nerubian Reinforced Quiver.

__NOTOC__ Nerubian Chitin is an item skinned off nerubian creatures in Northrend. It can be combined with skinning from Nerubian Chitin Fragment. It can also be crafted with Northrend Leatherworking (1); taught by trainers.
Nerubian Hive is a mail uncommon crafted set from the Wrath of the Lich King. It is crafted by Leatherworking.
Nerf Engineering (10 player) is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for defeating XT-002 Deconstructor without him recovering any health from XS-013 Scrapbots on 10-player mode.
Nerf Gravity Bombs (10 player) is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for defeating XT-002 Deconstructor without any raid member dying from a Gravity Bomb on 10-player mode.

Nerf Scrapbots (10 player) is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for defeating XS-013 Scrapbots within 12 seconds using XE-321 Boombots during XT-002 Deconstructor encounter in Ulduar on 10-player mode.

The Nerubian Guardians were a group of nerubian survivors who protected the entrance to Azjol-Nerub. They where slaughtered by Arthas Menethil and the Scourge when he was travelling towards Icecrown Citadel.

Nerdgasm in World of Warcraft is the state of euphoria players might feel after defeating a raid boss they have been wiping on for a long time. This often manifests itself in screaming and cheering over voice over IP software. It is sometimes heard at the end of boss kill videos posted on the internet.
Nerub'ar Broodkeepers are nerubians located in the first two rooms of Icecrown Citadel.
Nerub'ar Victims are web cocoons holding Horde members in Mightstone Quarry around Warsong Hold in the Borean Tundra.
Nemesis Shell Fragment is a quest item for Hell's Shells. It is a fragment from the shell of Nemesis, the corrupt Turtle God created by Twilight's Hammer.
Nether Fiends are fleshbeasts located in Undershell in the Abyssal Depths.
Nesingwary Hired Guns are guards located at Nesingwary's Expedition in Northern Stranglethorn. They defended the camp when it was attacked by Gurubashi trolls during the war against the Zandalari.
Netgun Gnomes are henchmen of Bingham Gadgetspring. Along with Zapper Gnomes, they patrol the area around his hideout.
Neptulon's Cache is a lootable chest located in the Throne of the Tides. It appears after Ozumat is defeated.
The Nerubian Obelisk is an archaeology keystone. It acts as 12 pieces of Nerubian Archaeology Fragments in research on Nerubian archaeology finds that have 'sockets'.

Nessa Maldy, daughter of the former trade prince Maldy, was a goblin living the good life from her father's mansion on the Isle of Kezan. Though Jastor Gallywix was smitten at her looks when he first saw her, he still took over everything she and her father owned in a quick and ruthless act and exiled the former trade prince from Kezan. Nessa, having gone from liking Jastor to hating him in under ten minutes, took her father by the shoulder and left. Every year Jastor sends Nessa a new painting of himself enjoying his riches, and in return she sends him plain boxes wired with explosives. Gallywix is still smitten with her, since he then says " who says long distance relationships don't work?

Neptulon's Rise is the hallway on the second floor in the Throne of the Tides. It is the first place players reach after getting off the Riptide. Lady Naz'jar is here releasing deep murlocs towards the players. She retreats to the Throne of Neptulon once players defeat the naga forces.

A net launcher looks like a a large blunderbuss with a small keg mounted at the end of its barrel. When the weapon is fired, the net carefully packed inside the keg shoots out. The nets for a net launcher are carefully designed for use with the weapon.

Nether Ward is a warlock talent on Tier 4 of the Destruction tree. It changes your Shadow Ward spell into Nether Ward, absorbing all spell damage instead of only shadow damage, provided you are within Demon Armor (Classic) or Fel Armor (BC Classic). The spell is otherwise unchanged.
Neduil Meadowshade is a night elf general goods vendor found at Sanctuary of Malorne in Mount Hyjal.
__NOTOC__ Neph'Lahim is one of three ogre magi maintaining a ritual to keep an Old God connected to L'ghorek in the Abyssal Depths.
Ner'gosh the Shadow is an orc warlock who leads the Blackrock clan located at the Altar of Storms in the northwestern portion of the Burning Steppes. He kneels at the altar, channeling a spell.

Neptool is a ghostly murloc quest giver on the Red Reaches shores of the Blasted Lands. He was the chief of the Rockpool murlocs and requests the aid of heroes to help recovery his village from the attacking Bloodwash naga.
The Nether Scion is a nether drake that has been captured by Twilight's Hammer and is being held in the Bastion of Twilight.
